facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 10 June 2026 states the adopted texts create ANSSI, mandated for cybersecurity and coordinating the response to cyberattacks.
The communique states the Government adopted the National Cybersecurity Strategy and its 2026-2030 Action Plan by Decree n°2026-0097/PT-RM of 25 February 2026.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de Cybersécurité du Mali

systems.system: Agence nationale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information (ANSSI)
